messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — planning to flip feature flag `new_rate_v2` for PLG cohort 3 tonight at 00:30 UTC. Need quick ops/finance checks: billing smoke, vendor mapping, grandfathered exemptions. @James @Rachel @Mateo please chime in.
James: From finance: +1 conditional. We need pre/post invoice snapshot and a recon script run. Threshold: hold if invoice delta > 3% or any failed invoice > 0.1%.
Rachel: Queueing a shadow run now, will post delta in ~25m. Also found a vendor mapping audit for ACME (vendor_id: acme-42) that looks flaky — flagging. billing-bot will emit diffs to #billing-webhooks.
Mateo: Ops suggestion: staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 60m observation windows. Rollback trigger: delta > 3% OR failed_invoices_pct > 0.1% OR manual hold from finance/ops/CS. Rollback flow: toggle flag -> trigger refund pipeline `REF-PRICING-2026` if we exceed thresholds.
Olivia: Proposed checklist (short):
  1) Billing smoke (Rachel) — run shadow and post CSV to Drive
  2) Vendor map verify (Rachel/Integrations) — ACME mapping fix?
  3) Grandfather list applied (James) — ensure exemptions not billed incorrectly
  4) CS notify top-10 customers (Caroline) — prepare template if we need outreach
  5) Ops schedule flag flip + alerting in #support and #customer-success (Mateo)
James: I'll run recon: `python tools/recon.py --before snapshots/before.json --after snapshots/after.json --threshold 0.03 --out drive:/finance/recon/new_rate_v2.csv` and post link when done.
billing-bot: invoice-diff job queued: id=8142, runner=shadow, eta=12m
Rachel: Shadow run initial pass: token cost delta = 2.1% over sample ~2k invoices. One vendor mismatch found: acme-42 legacy_plan_id didn't map to new_rate_v2. I'll push mapping patch in 12m.
Mateo: Ops will set rollout: 10% at 00:30, escalate to 50% at +60m if metrics OK, then 100% at +180m. I'll add automated metric checks to the flag. If any check trips, it sets flag back to 0% and pings this thread.
Caroline (CS): Please add a CS digest to the rollout: send short note to CS team with list of potentially impacted accounts (top-10 by revenue). I'll prepare template: "We may contact customers if billing anomalies are detected."
Olivia: Final approvals required by 00:15 UTC: James (finance), Rachel (validation), Mateo (ops). If any say HOLD we delay.
James: Sign-off (finance).
Rachel: Sign-off (validation). Patch for acme-42 deployed to staging; will confirm after second shadow run. Sign-off pending final shadow.
Mateo: Sign-off (ops). Scheduled flip at 00:30 UTC. Will post deploy-bot message when toggled.
Olivia: :thumbsup: Proceeding with 00:30 flip to 10% per plan.
--- (after flip) ---
deploy-bot: Feature flag `new_rate_v2` toggled to 10% by Mateo at 00:30:12 UTC
billing-bot: invoice-diff job 8142 completed: delta=2.8% (below 3% threshold). details: drive:/finance/recon/new_rate_v2_run1.csv
James: Good initial signal. Proceed to monitor for 60m then decide on ramp to 50%.
Rachel: Live metrics look stable; minor blips for 18 ACME accounts — I think mapping patch missed a sub-batch. Investigating.
Mateo: Holding on ramp until Rachel confirms ACME sub-batch.
Rachel: Confirmed — mapping patch didn't land for 200 ACME accounts due to id normalization bug. Root cause identified, PR opened: repo/integrations#342.
Olivia: Given that, we should pause the ramp and prepare rollback contingency. If we see billing diffs widen, rollback immediately.
billing-bot: invoice-diff job 8143 scheduled (post-10% run) id=8143, eta=10m
billing-bot: invoice-diff job 8143 completed: delta=4.6% (exceeds 3% threshold). failed_invoices_pct=0.12% > 0.1% threshold.
Mateo: Rolling back now -> toggling `new_rate_v2` to 0%. Opening incident and tagging SRE.
deploy-bot: Feature flag `new_rate_v2` toggled to 0% by Mateo at 01:45:03 UTC
Rachel: Confirmed rollback. Root cause: integrations id-normalizer skipped legacy IDs for acme-42; fix requires hotpatch and a re-run of mapping job.
James: Finance: prepare refund/offset plan for affected invoices and customers. I'll draft refund CSV and run automated refunds via `scripts/refund_batch.py --file refunds/acme_patch_2026.csv`.
Caroline (CS): I'll notify top-10 accounts with a friendly note and offer a billing review. Template ready.
Olivia: Postmortem action items (brief):
  - ship hotpatch for id-normalizer and run mapping backfill (Rachel/Integrations)
  - rerun full shadow with mapping validated (Rachel)
  - finance to prepare refund offsets + communicate internal ledger adjustments (James)
  - plan targeted canary next week with smaller cohort and extra monitoring (Ops/Finance/CS)
  - update rollout checklist with explicit vendor mapping verification step
James: I'll own refund CSV and internal accounting notes. ETA for refunds draft: 4h.
Rachel: Hotpatch PR merged to prod at 03:10 UTC, mapping backfill started. Will post follow-up shadow results to this thread.
Mateo: Closing immediate ops loop. Will coordinate next canary window once Rachel posts green shadow.
Olivia: Thanks everyone — great cross-team response. Saving thread as reference for postmortem.
